title: Ordinary counit and total tensor evaluation
statement: For any scheme X and any additive strong monoidal left adjoint P to S=Γ(X,-), let e:P_c⊣S_c be the induced cochain adjunction. Assume μP(SM,SN);P(sectionTensorMap(M,N));ε(M⊗N)=εM⊗εN for all module sheaves M,N. For any integer cochain complexes K,L, P_c(naiveMap(K,L));e.ε(K⊗L)=δP_c(S_cK,S_cL);(e.εK⊗e.εL), where δP_c is the totalized ordinary inverse tensor comparison and naiveMap is the actual coproduct construction of [lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain]. No derived categories or K-injectivity enter this statement.

source.place: Lemma 20.31.3, the adjunction polygon proof; assumed tensor and counit squares are Tags 0FP0/0FP1

proof.text: Precompose in every degree with tensor summand inclusions, using preservation of coproducts by P. The formula for the naive cup and naturality of the induced degreewise counit reduce the assertion to the assumed ordinary counit/tensor identity at K.X i,L.X j, after the inverse tensor constraint cancellation. Coproduct and cochain morphism extensionality conclude.

theorem moduleCup_cochain_counit_tensor
    (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [P.Additive] [P.Monoidal] [P.IsLeftAdjoint]
    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace)
    (hOrdinary : ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace),
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ P
          ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj M)
          ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj N) ≫
        P.map (moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X M N) ≫ adj.counit.app (M ⊗ N) =
          adj.counit.app M ⊗ₘ adj.counit.app N)
    (K L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let T := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let F := P.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    F.map (moduleCup_naiveMap X K L) ≫
        (adj.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app (K ⊗ L) =
      ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) P).app (T.obj K)).app (T.obj L) ≫
        ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app K ⊗ₘ
          (adj.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app L)
